instrument: Red Oak approvals for Compass Datacenters campus (instrument not yet identified)
summary: Compass Datacenters plans ten two-story data centers on agricultural land about the size of Central Park, one of seven campuses that together would cover more than a quarter of the town (about 20,000 residents). Residents allege the council approved it without public process.
notes: Compass states it has worked with the community for five years and cites closed-loop water and grid investment that does not shift costs to homes. Pull the zoning cases and council approvals. Ellis County proposed a $15 million animal shelter grant agreement in June (separate entry pending).
confidence_note: Relayed from broadcast; no approval instrument read.
